description: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike, backed entirely by remote sources through Gelato. No local media is assumed. Own auth/session runtime and directly rendered screens, not a reskin of native jellyfin-web components.
name: Jellio
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike.

versions.changelog:
## [1.20.0] - 2026-09-26

### 🚀 Features

- Proxy book search/requests through Shelfarr, backend only
- Show a native Jellyfin Books library as real book shelves
- Track book reading progress and add Continue Reading/Listening rows
- Add a native EPUB/PDF reader for Jellyfin Book items
- Add a native audiobook player for Jellyfin AudioBook items
- Request books from Shelfarr right on the Books shelf

### 🚜 Refactor

- Remove the Audiobookshelf integration now that books are native

## [1.19.0] - 2026-09-25

### 🚀 Features

- Re-embed Audiobookshelf in an iframe now that its CSP is fixed

### ◀️ Revert

- Open Audiobookshelf in a new tab, not an iframe

## [1.18.0] - 2026-09-25

### 🚀 Features

- Add a config-driven Books sidebar entry linking to Audiobookshelf

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Wait for the stopped-playback report before Home re-fetches Up Next/Continue Watching
